## What's new

- Work from a unified course workspace; lesson completion no longer depends on adding a layout.
- Build a bounded search plan from selected course materials, then review and explicitly save a case or video. Resource credentials are separate from AI credentials. Same-event source merging requires choosing an existing resource and confirming the merge; video clip times require the user to enter and confirm the timing.
- Extract and edit a PowerPoint style profile, inspect structural previews and visual inferences, then propose a supplemental slide through the existing AI connection with explicit context consent or enter a manual draft. Preview before exporting a single-slide file or an appended copy; the source file is preserved.

## Verification status

On 2026-10-21, the user accepted the documented PARTIAL and UNVERIFIED limits and authorized the v3.0.0 release. This authorization does not change any individual acceptance status below. See the [32-item acceptance record](https://github.com/wyzh0117/workbench/blob/workbench-3.0.0/docs/v3.0.0-acceptance.md) and [browser evidence](https://github.com/wyzh0117/workbench/blob/workbench-3.0.0/docs/acceptance/v3.0.0/README.md).

- Live Brave Search, YouTube, and AI inference were not tested with real credentials. Mock and local transport tests do not establish live service success.
- The production codec was exercised on two public MIT OCW PPTX samples (23 slides and 8 slides); provenance, source hashes, receipt, and ten output package hashes are in the [PPTX sample evidence](https://github.com/wyzh0117/workbench/blob/workbench-3.0.0/docs/acceptance/v3.0.0/pptx-real-samples.md). This is package-level evidence only; each sample has one master. Real multi-master courseware, legacy `.ppt`, broader damaged-package cases, and opening exported files in PowerPoint, checking for Repair, editing, saving, and reopening remain unverified. The two samples do not establish Office compatibility or represent two distinct courseware classes; a truncated package was rejected in a separate probe.
- The structural SVG preview is not rendered by PowerPoint and does not establish visual fidelity. True 150%/200% text scaling and real IME input remain unverified; PERF-01 is partial.
- The first local `.app` build without an explicit signing identity failed `codesign --verify --deep --strict` with a resource-sealing error. Rebuilding with the release workflow's `APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY='-'` passed strict verification; this is ad-hoc signing with no Team ID, not Developer ID signing or notarization. The corresponding ARM64 DMG passed `hdiutil verify`; an earlier sandboxed DMG attempt failed with `hdiutil: Device not configured`, then the controlled rerun passed without packaging changes. The release workflow now gates asset staging on strict app verification.

The implementation candidate is commit `f1de6643c0d2cb9023bfbf42a87d85a870adb2fa`. Workflow/version-check commit `2775c9d2aecff38caa95622859206233a0770c6a` was verified by the corrected [build-only run](https://github.com/wyzh0117/workbench/actions/runs/39482060115) (`workflow_dispatch`); macOS and Windows jobs passed, while the GitHub Release job was skipped. The macOS app passed `codesign --verify --deep --strict`, and `lipo` reported `x86_64 arm64`; it is ad-hoc signed with no Team ID and is not notarized. The Windows installer version resource reported ProductVersion/FileVersion `3.0.0` and ProductName `AI Course Workbench`.

The verified build-only artifacts and matching SHA-256 sidecars are:

- `AI-Course-Workbench-macOS.dmg` — 16,069,712 bytes; `da0e1d2b20329c0e3adaf923efe52bc64bd2a948c540afb50d1866f840a20feb`. The downloaded DMG passed `hdiutil verify`.
- `AI-Course-Workbench-Windows-x64-setup.exe` — 5,519,408 bytes; `5923fb496517e26442b7ed89a4429d95e0f5ca83212142df4abbff776981b2fe`.

The first [build-only run](https://github.com/wyzh0117/workbench/actions/runs/39480132218) built the Windows app and NSIS installer, then failed the version check because it compared `3.0.0` with the branch name `workbench-3.0.0`; no artifact was uploaded. The macOS job remained queued and the run was canceled. The check now compares installer metadata with `tauri.conf.json`. The asset hashes above are from the earlier build-only run, not the tag-triggered release build.
